aboutPage.title: A private inbound studio for Sri Lanka
aboutPage.intro: Hai Sri Lanka Tours crafts private day tours and multi day journeys with local hosts, unhurried pacing, and pay at destination booking.

aboutPage.story2: We design routes around Galle, the Cultural Triangle, Kandy, tea country, Yala, and the south coast, then stay reachable by email and WhatsApp from first enquiry to departure.

privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
privacyPage.intro: How Hai Sri Lanka Tours collects, uses, and protects personal information when you browse, enquire, or book.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.body: Hai Sri Lanka Tours (Hai Sri Lanka) is an inbound travel company based in Colombo, Sri Lanka. Contact: haisrilankatour@gmail.com or +94 74 313 7241.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body: When you use the contact or booking forms we collect your name, email, phone or WhatsApp number, travel dates, group size, and the message you send. Server logs may include IP address and basic device data needed to operate the website.

sections.title: How we use information
sections.body: We use your details to reply to enquiries, confirm private tours, arrange logistics, and send booking related email. We do not sell personal data. Analytics run only after you accept cookies.

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
sections.body: Essential cookies keep the site working. Analytics and advertising cookies (including Google) load only if you choose “Accept all” on the consent banner. You can continue with essential cookies only.

sections.title: Sharing and retention
sections.body: We may share details with trusted suppliers (drivers, hotels, activity partners) solely to deliver your journey. We keep enquiry and booking records as long as needed for the trip and legal accounting, then delete or anonymise them.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You may ask to access, correct, or delete personal data we hold, or withdraw marketing consent, by emailing haisrilankatour@gmail.com. You may also contact your local data protection authority.

privacyPage.ctaBody: Email or WhatsApp us and we will explain how your enquiry is handled.

termsPage.title: Terms of service
termsPage.intro: These terms apply when you enquire about or book a private tour with Hai Sri Lanka Tours.

sections.title: Booking requests
sections.body: Submitting a booking form is a request, not a guaranteed confirmation. We review dates and availability, then confirm by email or WhatsApp. No online payment is taken to place a request.

sections.title: Payment
sections.body: Unless we agree otherwise in writing, tours are paid at destination in the currency confirmed in your booking email. Prices on the website are estimates and may change with season, group size, or custom changes.

sections.title: Changes and cancellation
sections.body: Tell us as soon as plans change. Most private tours can be cancelled free of charge with reasonable notice. Late changes, no shows, or supplier fees (tickets, lodges) may still apply and will be explained before you confirm.

sections.title: Your responsibilities
sections.body: Provide accurate traveler details, valid contact information, and any mobility or dietary needs. Follow local temple dress codes and wildlife park rules. You are responsible for passports, visas, and travel insurance.

sections.title: Liability
sections.body: We take care in planning private journeys. We are not liable for delays, weather, park closures, traffic, or events outside our reasonable control. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited under Sri Lankan law.

sections.title: Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Sri Lanka. For questions, contact Hai Sri Lanka Tours, No. 12 Galle Road, Colombo, or haisrilankatour@gmail.com.

termsPage.ctaBody: Request a private tour and we will confirm details before you travel.
